THE LAST LITTLE STEP

From artwork to
your Mac cursor.

Your download is a transparent image. To use it as a system cursor, you'll need a separate Mac cursor manager such as Mousecape.

Before you begin

This guide is general guidance. Mousecape behavior varies by macOS version, and we have not yet validated every system combination. PNG files do not install themselves or carry a guaranteed Mousecape hotspot.

01

Download your artwork

Export your transparent PNG from the studio. Copy the size and hotspot coordinates shown alongside it.

02

Create a cape in Mousecape

Open Mousecape, create a new cape, add the cursor role you want to change, and place your PNG into its image field. The Mousecape project instructions describe creating and editing capes.

03

Set the click point and test

Use the exported hotspot coordinates as a reference when configuring the cursor. Apply the cape, then test it in several apps. If it does not take effect, check your Mousecape and macOS compatibility.

Want your original cursor back?

Return to Mousecape and remove or reset the applied cape. Exact menu names may vary by release.

Read about a reported macOS 26 compatibility issue ↗
